name: estimatekit
description: Connects ChatGPT to a home service shop's EstimateKit account (HVAC, plumbing or electrical): the day's to-do list, customers, jobs and invoices, and good-better-best draft quotes.

interface.longDescription:
EstimateKit connects ChatGPT to a home service shop's EstimateKit account, so the owner or office can check the business and draft customer quotes in a conversation. EstimateKit is quoting and job software for small HVAC, plumbing and electrical shops.

- See what needs you today: overdue invoices (including part-paid ones), finished jobs not yet invoiced, approved quotes waiting for a date, quotes a customer opened but hasn't answered, and jobs with no technician.
- Look up any customer with their installed equipment (brand, model, serial, age), maintenance plan, quotes, jobs and invoices.
- Draft good, better, best quotes from your own templates or price book, at your prices and tax rates. Every quote is saved as a draft for you to review and send from EstimateKit.
- Add and update customers from an email, a voicemail or call notes.

Safe by design: the app never sends anything to a customer, never deletes anything, and can't record payments or change your prices, settings or team. It sees exactly what your EstimateKit login can see, so a technician only sees their own view. Disconnect any time in EstimateKit under Connectors.

Requires an existing EstimateKit account (estimatekit.com).
